|translation='''Title:''' Undercover (Dark).

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your spy at a location card. The spy moves to the opponent's side of that location. The spy becomes undercover. During your deploy phase, if it is at a location, you may choose to reveal its identity (this Effect is lost). This Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
The Empire always maintains a spy network. It plots infiltration of the Rebel Alliance and the spread of false information about its own operations.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter.
